mapper.insert: /* isry.cysns.casemng.casetrmn.mapper.saveData - Hee Sung Yoon */ MERGE INTO ACA200 USING DUAL ON (CASE_MNG_NO = #{CASE_MNG_NO} AND CASE_MNG_ODRNO = #{CASE_MNG_ODRNO}) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET AFTFCT_INTNET_DGNSS_SE_CD = #{AFTFCT_INTNET_DGNSS_SE_CD}, AFTFCT_SMRTP_DGNSS_SE_CD = #{AFTFCT_SMRTP_DGNSS_SE_CD}, AFTFCT_CHILDR_DGNSS_SE_CD = #{AFTFCT_CHILDR_DGNSS_SE_CD}, AFTFCT_GAMBLE_DGNSS_SE_CD = #{AFTFCT_GAMBLE_DGNSS_SE_CD}, MEDIAA_SCHL_SE_CD = #{SCHL_SE_CD}, LAST_MDFCN_DT = SYSDATE, LAST_MDFR_ID = #{USER_ID} WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( CASE_MNG_NO, CASE_MNG_ODRNO, TRPR_INFO_NO, DGNSS_EXMN_MNG_NO, LINK_TYPE_SE_CD, RELA_INST_NM, TRPR_CHAR_SE_CD, BEFFAT_INTNET_DGNSS_SE_CD, BEFFAT_SMRTP_DGNSS_SE_CD, ADDTNG_TRL_INSP_ENFORC_YN, MDLRT_SPRT_YN, MDLRT_RESULT_OPIN_CN, CMPN_OPIN_CN, PIC_OPIN_CN, AFTFCT_INTNET_DGNSS_SE_CD, AFTFCT_SMRTP_DGNSS_SE_CD, FRST_RGTR_ID, FRST_REG_DT, LAST_MDFR_ID, LAST_MDFCN_DT ) VALUES ( #{CASE_MNG_NO}, #{CASE_MNG_ODRNO}, #{TRPR_INFO_NO}, #{DGNSS_EXMN_MNG_NO}, #{LINK_TYPE_SE_CD}, #{RELA_INST_NM}, #{TRPR_CHAR_SE_CD}, #{BEFFAT_INTNET_DGNSS_SE_CD}, #{BEFFAT_SMRTP_DGNSS_SE_CD}, #{ADDTNG_TRL_INSP_ENFORC_YN}, #{MDLRT_SPRT_YN}, #{MDLRT_RESULT_OPIN_CN}, #{CMPN_OPIN_CN}, #{PIC_OPIN_CN}, #{AFTFCT_INTNET_DGNSS_SE_CD}, #{AFTFCT_SMRTP_DGNSS_SE_CD}, #{USER_ID}, SYSDATE, #{USER_ID}, SYSDATE )
mapper.select: /* selectProbmSttsById - Lee MS */ SELECT MIN(DECODE(B.PROBM_STTS_MLSFC_SE_CD, '0601', '1')) AS PROBM_STTS1, /* 정신건강-자살 */ MIN(DECODE(B.PROBM_STTS_MLSFC_SE_CD, '0602', '1')) AS PROBM_STTS2, /* 정신건강-자해 */ MIN(DECODE(B.PROBM_STTS_MLSFC_SE_CD, '0802', '1')) AS PROBM_STTS3, /* 폭력가해-청소년폭력 */ A.CASE_MNG_NO AS CASE_MNG_NO, /* 사례관리번호 */ A.CASE_MNG_ODRNO AS CASE_MNG_ODRNO /* 사례관리차수 */ FROM ACA120 A, SEB130 B /* 문제상태및원인(A) */ WHERE A.CASE_MNG_NO = B.CASE_MNG_NO AND A.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = B.CASE_MNG_ODRNO AND A.CASE_MNG_NO = #{CASE_MNG_NO} AND A.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = #{CASE_MNG_ODRNO} AND A.GNRLZ_CRISIS_DGREE_SE_CD = '3' /* 고위험군 */ AND B.PROBM_STTS_MLSFC_SE_CD IN ('0601', '0602', '0802') /*자살(0601), 자해(0602), 청소년폭력(0802) */ GROUP BY A.CASE_MNG_NO, A.CASE_MNG_ODRNO
